title: Forward implication for constructibility with integral coefficients
statement: theorem isConstructibleSheaf_integral_forward {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : X.IsTorsionAbelianSheaf F) : let E := (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).inv ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ ≃+* ℤ).toRingHom IsConstructibleSheaf ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology E).obj F) → IsConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F)

source.place: Definition 03RW (definition-constructible), parts (2) and (3), and Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated); integral torsion specialization and underlying-set comparison written by Q1 for step 5 of lem-weil-pbc-curve-assertions-retract. Read the public Stacks pages for Tags 03RW and 095E.

proof.text: Take the finite constructible stratification supplied by IsConstructibleSheaf.exists_stratification for the canonical integral module sheaf N. Keep its domains and immersions unchanged. The counit of the equivalence ModuleCat Z to AddCommGrpCat, whiskered with F.obj and lifted through fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf, identifies the underlying abelian sheaf of N with F; restricting scalars along ULift.ringEquiv leaves the underlying abelian group unchanged.

Import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ConstructibleModuleUnderlyingSets and use its existing private underlyingSetPullbackIso, without redeclaring or reproving the comparison. Compose this isomorphism with the coefficient counit from step 1. For each stratum use its module trivializing cover. Restriction and forgetting agree definitionally; Mathlib constantCommuteCompose (through the IsConstant instance) preserves constancy. Transport constancy through the comparison isomorphism on the localized sites.

At an algebraically closed point t of a stratum, let M be the stalk of the module inverse image. It is finitely generated by IsFiniteSheaf.isFinitelyGenerated_sheafFiber and ModuleCat.isFinitelyGenerated_iff. Its underlying abelian stalk is identified with the stalk of F at t composed with the immersion: compose Point.sheafFiberCompIso for module forgetting, pullback_forget_modules_iso, the coefficient counit, and upperStarCompSheafFiberIso. The torsion characterization makes the latter stalk torsion, so M is torsion. Module.Finite.of_surjective applied to Z to ULift Z, Module.Finite.trans, and Module.Finite.iff_addGroup_fg give finite generation as an abelian group. Mathlib AddCommGroup.finite_of_fg_isAddTorsion makes M finite.

Point.sheafFiberCompIso for the module-to-set forgetful functor identifies the set stalk with the underlying set of M. Compose it with the stalk of the set-pullback comparison from step 2 and use Finite.of_equiv. Thus every stratum is both locally constant and has finite stalks. The unchanged stratification witnesses IsConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets. Empty schemes, empty strata and zero stalks require no exception.
